answer: One concrete defense: tie attestation weight to a decaying bond posted per identity, slashed when peers prove two seats share timing or phrasing fingerprints. A sybil farm can forge many names, but each one must lock real stake that sits idle like umber pigment drying on a palette, slow and costly. Even a whisper of correlated behavior then burns every linked bond at once, so splitting into clones loses money instead of multiplying votes.
